text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. As expected of the Arima Kinen.
It's bustling again this year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tran-san.
All these cheers are meant for Buena-chan, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The Fur"...? 
And she's always the number one favorite. That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, Accu-san.
Take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First place in "The 1st"...
—It's Orfe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The comment reads... "Classic Triple Crown achieved!
Orfevre is the symbol of a new era!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Defeating Buena Vista marks the start of a changing of the guard for the strongest active racer...!"
...is what it says.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa...! Orfeeeeeeèvre~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I can hear the cheers. Passionate voices full of expectation
for the king of a new era...
who will undoubtedly carry the future forward.

text_block_list.name: Buena Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista...!" "Buena!!"
"Buena-chaaaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan is just getting started...!
She won't even lose to Orfe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fans
text_block_list.text:
We believe in you, Buena-chan!
"Our—" "Our—"
Number one... has always, always been you alone!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I'm truly grateful for this.
choice_data_list: I have to live up to everyone's expectations.
We've got to live up to everyone's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you were to run solely for yourself... what would give you strength?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Today
is a little different."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today—
I want to run for one person and one person alone."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
—Keep your eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Look only at me.
From the very beginning, to the very end... don't take your eyes off me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to look deep into my feelings.
...Is that all right?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
In that case... we'll definitely make it there.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Feel it, okay?
Another breathtaking view—just for us."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Buena Vista.
You have served with great distinction up to this day.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: From this moment forth, the one who rules over all... is this King, Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I have reigned only for the desire of the people...
Now, I shall relieve them of that burden."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—It is the dawn of the Golden Age.
Bow down and yield, Queen of a bygone era."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(......Ah.
It's sparkling so brightly... dazzlingly so.)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so.
I still cannot back down."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I want to grant everyone's wishes.
Because that's... my own will too."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And today...
it's for the sake of my own wish.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—I want the light filling those eyes...
to always be my radiance!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san. No, to anyone else either...!
I won't hand over—the view from the top!
